'''Day of Repentance''' is a feast held at the first half moon after [[High Chasaline]].{{Ref/book|bwb}}

It is celebrated in [[Cairhien]]. According to Min, it includes "sedate dancing" at night, and she asks Rand to join her for it.<ref>''[[A Crown of Swords]]'', [[A Crown of Swords/Chapter 33|chapter 33]].</ref>
